en: Black‑and‑white panoramic industrial scene showing a large factory complex with tall smokestacks emitting dark smoke, set against rocky hills and wooded slopes. In the foreground are tram tracks with electric streetcars, several horse‑drawn wagons, and people walking along a fenced street. The mid‑ground has multiple industrial buildings, rail sidings and freight cars. The sky and upper border show heavy damage or overpainting from age or reproduction. One horse cart bears a sign on the side.
